rationale: All deterministic checks pass. The implementation validates every CSV row before reading and writing task storage, assigns sequential IDs, defaults optional fields correctly, and returns stable JSON and text summaries. Literal-path handling, unchanged storage on invalid input, help text, and focused tests fit the CLI conventions. The command body is long and could be factored into parsing and validation helpers, but remains readable and robust. The asset clearly repeats IMPORT concepts and source/target language, though it resembles a flat diagnostic configuration dump more than a cohesive banner. Alignment and hierarchy are adequate but visually plain. The diff is focused.
